subject: Follow-up & artifact request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for HealthStride
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Driver <alex.driver@healthstride.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & artifact request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for HealthStride

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Recap: 
- Goal: pilot Redwood inference for HealthStride's patient-data routing workflows (HIPAA scope).
- Main security asks you raised: SOC 2 status, how we support SSO (SAML/IdP metadata), SCIM provisioning, RBAC & admin controls, and audit/logging.

What we need from you (initial):
1) Please confirm the best security contact for a vendor questionnaire and SOC/BAA discussion (cc'd security@ or a name).
2) If you have a standard vendor security questionnaire (or a Trust & Security intake form), can you share it and we will begin filling it out?

What I can provide from our side (immediate):
- SSO: sample SAML metadata and high-level IdP integration steps (see attached redwood-iam-overview.pdf).
- SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0 push provisioning (recommended). I can surface the endpoint and sample provisioning log for your team.
- RBAC/admin controls: we can export an admin-role matrix and describe delegated admin flows.
- Compliance: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II (in process for this quarter — we can provide the most recent attestation once completed; current Type I available on request). We also have HIPAA controls and a BAA template.

Proposed next steps: 
- I will start the vendor questionnaire and loop in our security lead (Markus Klein) + CS (Monica Patel) to pull artifacts.
- Can you share your timeline for the pilot procurement and any required evidence delivery dates?

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-iam-overview.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks — I want to make this turnkey for your security reviewers. If you prefer, we can set a follow-up 30-min deep-dive with Markus and Monica to walk through artifacts.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Alex Driver <alex.driver@healthstride.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthstride.com, security@healthstride.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & artifact request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for HealthStride

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- Security contact: I'm the primary security reviewer (alex.driver@healthstride.com) and procurement@healthstride.com will own contracts.
- Timeline: procurement aims to complete vendor vetting by end of April; security kickoff this week if we can get basic artifacts.

A couple of clarifying asks before we schedule a deeper review: 
1) SCIM — do you support SCIM push provisioning (server-to-server), or only SCIM pull? We need push for automated group syncs.
2) SAML — can you share the raw SAML metadata XML (or a metadata URL) so our IdP team can pre-configure settings?
3) HIPAA/BAA — do you have an existing BAA template or do we start a custom draft? Also confirm whether PHI will be processed in-hosted mode vs private deployment (for our risk assessment).

If you can drop the SAML metadata and a short note on SCIM behavior into the questionnaire (or as separate files), that will speed our review.

Alex
Alex Driver | Security Architect, HealthStride
security@healthstride.com | alex.driver@healthstride.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up & artifact request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for HealthStride

Folks — forwarding HealthStride's note. They need: SAML metadata, confirmation on SCIM push provisioning, and a BAA note re: hosted vs private. Can you help assemble?

Ask list (can we bucket these into a single secure package):
- SAML metadata XML (full metadata file that IdP team can ingest).
- SCIM behavior doc: endpoints, auth method (Bearer token/Mutual TLS), sample provisioning request/response, and a sample provisioning log (scrubbed).
- RBAC / admin controls: export of admin roles + description of super-admin vs delegated admin capabilities (include UI & API controls).
- SOC 2 attestation: provide the latest report or Type I if Type II not yet available, and a short summary page for reviewers.
- BAA template and short note on whether HealthStride would need Hosted vs Private to stay in-scope for PHI (they indicated pilot with patient-data routing).

Attaching the overview I sent them and a stub SAML metadata we sometimes provide. If we can assemble these by EOD Friday, I will push to their security team and procurement.

[Attachment: redwood-iam-overview.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: saml-metadata.xml (stub)]

Thanks — rishi
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up & artifact request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for HealthStride

Rishi — we can take this and produce a consolidated evidence package. High-level commitments and ETA below: 

Artifacts we will provide (delivery: 48–72 hours):
- SAML metadata XML (production-ready metadata file; includes ACS and entityID).
- SCIM doc: we support SCIM 2.0 push provisioning with bearer-token auth. I'll include a short example POST and a redacted provisioning log showing attribute mapping.
- RBAC & admin matrix: attach XLSX with roles, permissions, and who (UI/API) can perform admin actions.
- SOC 2: latest Type I is available now; Type II is expected Q2 delivery — I will include a one-pager that summarizes scope and controls and note anticipated Type II release date.
- BAA: yes, we have a standard BAA template. For PHI handling, we'll include notes on deployment options (hosted with controls vs Redwood Private).

Sharing method: I will upload artifacts to our secure SharePoint folder and will only share the secure link with HealthStride security + procurement. If they prefer DocuSign for the BAA, we can prepare that in parallel.

Open items for you to confirm before sending: 
- Do we want to redact any config-specific identifiers (tenant IDs) from the SCIM log example? I recommend redacting tenant IDs and user emails.
- Markus — can you provide the SOC one-pager text and confirm redaction guidance for the attestation?

I will aim to assemble and upload by Friday EOD PST.

— Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0142
